name: Populations
line: A light Powers of Ten: after a dawn-lit hero, a pinned field zooms continuously from one ringed person to ten, a hundred (10 to 12 smokers in red), a thousand and a million, with caption cards, a powers-of-ten readout and a sky that brightens from dawn to day.
notes: The million really is a million: ten nested blocks per level, drawn with culling and a pre-rendered tile pyramid so it stays smooth; below about 6 px per dot each hundred is drawn as area-true bands (10 rows in 100 red, 2 dots the range), so at the million scale the rate reads as a fine warm hatch rather than countable dots. Reduced motion snaps to the four captioned scales; without JavaScript a static 100-dot SVG is shown. Young Serif has no Cyrillic (Onest does), and Young Serif has a single weight.
